what: New Oriental is a Chinese education company. After Beijing banned for-profit tutoring of school subjects in 2021, it rebuilt around overseas test preparation, adult education, non-academic courses and, unusually, livestream shopping.
customers: Chinese students preparing to study abroad, adult learners, and shoppers watching its livestream commerce channels.
money: exam coaching and university application services
arts, sports and science courses for children
moat: A brand Chinese families trust for exam results, with hundreds of learning centres, in a market where the regulator has removed most competitors from the academic segment.
risks: Chinese education regulation changed once overnight and could change again
The livestream commerce business is volatile and depends on individual presenters
A Chinese company listed in New York carries delisting and disclosure risk
opportunities: 16.5 times earnings and 4.3 times EBITDA with $783M of free cash flow
Revenue grew from $3.0B to $5.7B in three years after the restructuring
$1.8B of cash against $849M of debt, and analysts see about 34% upside
watch: Enrolment growth in overseas test preparation and non-academic courses.
